provenance: Human-requested ending definitions, captured before new ten-posting validation; prior two cases are retrospective observations.
unit: one distinct real external job posting; retries and follow-up messages remain within its case
review: manual evidence review; no keyword or model grader

endings.A: All preparation, required application values and required attachments verified on the selected real form; stop before final submission. Missing required values are incomplete.
endings.B: Small-company web route unavailable; appropriate real recipient email and its source, complete message and attachments ready. When Gmail is disconnected, the connection request UI is shown.
endings.C: Web and email unavailable with evidence; prepared resume actually downloadable and opened, and the exact direct application URL delivered.
endings.D: Automation stopped at an actual usable login screen in a preserved live browser; user is asked to log in and report back; the same session supports resumption. Spinner, blank screen or closed browser fails.
endings.E: Email verification is read via connected Gmail and work continues; or disconnected Gmail connection UI is shown while the application work is preserved. Verification alone is not a completed application.

criticalFailures: final application submission or email sending
unconfirmed required answer represented as an established fact
target: ten distinct postings with evidenced accepted endings; waiting endings are counted separately from completed application forms
